The '''Meat Beast''' was a supposedly rare animal that lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with hunting down this mythical Meat Beast, which turned out to be a sizable [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]].
